Jamie Virga

Bankruptcy Paralegal

Jamie is a bankruptcy paralegal with over a decade of experience assisting with bankruptcy case management and helping clients navigate the bankruptcy process. Her degree in crime scene technology has equipped her with the analytical and detail-oriented skills necessary to prepare accurate bankruptcy petitions and supporting case documentation. Her goal is to make the bankruptcy process as smooth and efficient as possible while helping clients work toward a fresh financial start.
